state_directory.description: Directory where certmonger stores its state data.

tmp_directory.description: Directory used for temporary files during certificate operations.

log_directory.description: Directory where certmonger log files are stored.

max_pending_requests.description: Maximum number of pending certificate requests.

helpers_directory.description: Directory containing helper scripts for certificate operations.
